detailed_descriptions.en: ~ In the year 29XX interplanetary wars erupted as a nanite plague spread to every star colony decimating the human populations. On the planet Celestious survivors scavenge subterranean zones for supplies and lost tech while battling the bandits, beasts, and monster that stalk the blackouts. ~ Gameplay Deadzoned is a traditional turn-based action Roguelike in a sci-fi setting. Venture ever-deeper into the Deadzones blasting through a wide assortment of enemies from critters and creatures, to gangs of outlaws and cultists, and terrifying monsters of the blackouts. To survive you'll need shrewd wits to make best use of the busted up weapons, gear, and limited ammo you stumble upon as you decide whether fully exploring the enemy strewn zones is worth the gamble. Thankfully murdering meanies gives XP to level up your Stats and Talent choices to customise your build. Features Every playthrough a procedurally-generated nightmare: Each zone fight through a unique layout facing random events as you level-up differently with special talents, find rusting weapons and strange gear, interact with ancient machines to boost your build, and fight or avoid the enemies that infest them. Fast arcade action: There's no agonising over item weight limits, loot everything you find and blast your way through the meanies to get the biggest score you can muster.. but keep an eye on your weapon's durability and ammo! Multiple game modes: Fancy a quick 20 minute trip? Or maybe a more lengthy session? You choose how deep the journey goes with each offering their own length, difficulty, and pools of gear, enemies, and end bosses. Many character classes: From Bounty Hunters, Psychics, Wizards, Busted Robots, and Technomaniacs, to the humble Deprived Wretch, each class levels up differently with each class having their own Talents and stat preferences. Eventful: Zones can have multiple random events you can face or avoid for extra loot and bigger scores. From wiping out camps of Cannibals and Gang Scum, or deal with skelly summoning Boneraisers. to setting foot in Black Markets, Arcane Libraries, mind altering Fungus Fields, or even... biege wallpaper lined backrooms. Optional Difficulty: You will also find optional entrances into special Deadzones such as Forbidden, Plagued, or Cursed Deadzones, where rarer treasurers and more dangerous meanies await needed for the biggest scores. Devices/Spells: Find rare special items to be used at any time to get you out of a tight spot. From making you invisible, teleporting you back to the zone entrance, summon devilish imp friends, or transform meanies into Slimes. Jam Packed: Discover and fill out your Compendium with over 75+ weapons, 50+ gear items, 25+ special items, 100+ enemies, and 15+ end bosses. Steam Leaderboards: Battle your foes, and your friends, to reach first place on the online Steam leaderboards. Every game mode and class has their own leaderboard to fight over. Clashful Cards: Take a cosy break from the blasting with a strategic collectable card game you can play against the AI or a local friend. Input Accessibility: Although Mouse + Keyboard is recommended, you can choose to play on a gamepad, or just a keyboard or mouse. Hat & Skin Colour unlocks: Now this is fashion zone! ~ Can YOU survive the zones? Or will you become just another Deadzoned? ~

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
~ In the year 29XX interplanetary wars erupted as a nanite plague spread to every star colony decimating the human populations. On the planet Celestious survivors scavenge subterranean zones for supplies and lost tech while battling the bandits, beasts, and monster that stalk the blackouts. ~

Gameplay

Deadzoned is a traditional turn-based action Roguelike in a sci-fi setting. Venture ever-deeper into the Deadzones blasting through a wide assortment of enemies from critters and creatures, to gangs of outlaws and cultists, and terrifying monsters of the blackouts.

To survive you'll need shrewd wits to make best use of the busted up weapons, gear, and limited ammo you stumble upon as you decide whether fully exploring the enemy strewn zones is worth the gamble. Thankfully murdering meanies gives XP to level up your Stats and Talent choices to customise your build.

Features

  • Every playthrough a procedurally-generated nightmare: Each zone fight through a unique layout facing random events as you level-up differently with special talents, find rusting weapons and strange gear, interact with ancient machines to boost your build, and fight or avoid the enemies that infest them.

  • Fast arcade action: There's no agonising over item weight limits, loot everything you find and blast your way through the meanies to get the biggest score you can muster.. but keep an eye on your weapon's durability and ammo!

  • Multiple game modes: Fancy a quick 20 minute trip? Or maybe a more lengthy session? You choose how deep the journey goes with each offering their own length, difficulty, and pools of gear, enemies, and end bosses.

  • Many character classes: From Bounty Hunters, Psychics, Wizards, Busted Robots, and Technomaniacs, to the humble Deprived Wretch, each class levels up differently with each class having their own Talents and stat preferences.

  • Eventful: Zones can have multiple random events you can face or avoid for extra loot and bigger scores. From wiping out camps of Cannibals and Gang Scum, or deal with skelly summoning Boneraisers. to setting foot in Black Markets, Arcane Libraries, mind altering Fungus Fields, or even... biege wallpaper lined backrooms.

  • Optional Difficulty: You will also find optional entrances into special Deadzones such as Forbidden, Plagued, or Cursed Deadzones, where rarer treasurers and more dangerous meanies await needed for the biggest scores.

  • Devices/Spells: Find rare special items to be used at any time to get you out of a tight spot. From making you invisible, teleporting you back to the zone entrance, summon devilish imp friends, or transform meanies into Slimes.

  • Jam Packed: Discover and fill out your Compendium with over 75+ weapons, 50+ gear items, 25+ special items, 100+ enemies, and 15+ end bosses.

  • Steam Leaderboards: Battle your foes, and your friends, to reach first place on the online Steam leaderboards. Every game mode and class has their own leaderboard to fight over.

  • Clashful Cards: Take a cosy break from the blasting with a strategic collectable card game you can play against the AI or a local friend.

  • Input Accessibility: Although Mouse + Keyboard is recommended, you can choose to play on a gamepad, or just a keyboard or mouse.

  • Hat & Skin Colour unlocks: Now this is fashion zone!

~ Can YOU survive the zones? Or will you become just another Deadzoned? ~
